none: PAS LIN-A57F65: Roman silver finger ring
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

An incomplete silver Roman finger ring, Henig Type VIII. The ring has a small raised oval bezel. The bezel is worn and there is only a feint transverse line visible. It is unclear whether this is a scratch or perhaps the cross-bar of a letter 'T' as in 'TOT' which is often seen on rings of this type from Lincolnshire.
